method: Selective three-way source integration; source repository has unrelated history. Only new selected SQL migrations are applied to an existing database.
policy: Preserve local configuration and prior Scarlet Halls, logout, class and logging fixes.
Exclude level-one riding/flight, free heirlooms, progression bypasses, automatic quest-objective completion, global stat reductions, extra loot and drop/yield boosts.
Keep boss mechanics and attunements; disable imported bot actions that directly alter combat state instead of using abilities.
Optional new bot-account pool defaults to disabled; accounts use random passwords if explicitly enabled.
Keep native quest auto-submit only where objectives still require normal completion.
Keep normal Grand Commendation reputation bonuses, which require earning and purchasing the account unlock.
